name: shader-warp-storm
title: Shader Warp Storm
description: Deep violet and lavender storm of marbled fluid. A WebGL shader backdrop; the storm preset of shader-warp.
useWhen: A dramatic, turbulent intro in deep violet.
Foreground is light text or a bright product shot that needs a dark field around it.
You want a finished Warp look without tuning the palette and parameters yourself.
avoidWhen: The video must use your brand colors: start from `shader-warp` and set `colors`.
You want a lighter, contrasting mood from the same shader: use `shader-warp-cream`.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Colors
variables.description: Up to 10 colors, comma separated, blended along the folds.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast the folds move. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Proportion
variables.description: Balance between the colors in the pattern.

variables.label: Softness
variables.description: How softly the colors blend. 0 gives hard bands.

variables.label: Distortion
variables.description: How far noise pushes the pattern around.

variables.label: Swirl
variables.description: How strongly the pattern is folded into swirls.

variables.label: Swirl iterations
variables.description: How many times the swirl is applied. More makes finer folds.

variables.label: Pattern scale
variables.description: Size of the pattern cells or stripes.

variables.label: Scale
variables.description: Zooms the pattern in or out.

variables.label: Offset X
variables.description: Moves the pattern sideways, in frame widths.

variables.label: Offset Y
variables.description: Moves the pattern up or down, in frame heights.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster but softens fine detail.
